candidate.Reason: The PickleSerializer class implements both pickle.dumps and pickle.loads methods, which can lead to remote code execution if untrusted data is deserialized. This is a known security risk with pickle.

The get_serializer function allows clients to specify the serializer via HTTP headers, including the insecure pickle serializer, without any authentication or validation of the data being deserialized.
